verses.en: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
verses.pt: Ora, havia entre os fariseus um homem chamado Nicodemos, um dos principais dos judeus.
verses.en_web: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
verses.en_bbe: Now there was among the Pharisees a man named Nicodemus, who was one of the rulers of the Jews.

verses.en: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
verses.pt: Este foi ter com Jesus, de noite, e disse-lhe: Rabi, sabemos que és Mestre, vindo de Deus; pois ninguém pode fazer estes sinais que tu fazes, se Deus não estiver com ele.
verses.en_web: The same came to him by night, and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
verses.en_bbe: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, Rabbi, we are certain that you have come from God as a teacher, because no man would be able to do these signs which you do if God was not with him.

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade te digo que se alguém não nascer de novo, não pode ver o reino de Deus.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to him, Truly, I say to you, Without a new birth no man is able to see the kingdom of God.

verses.en: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?
verses.pt: Perguntou-lhe Nicodemos: Como pode um homem nascer, sendo velho? porventura pode tornar a entrar no ventre de sua mãe, e nascer?
verses.en_web: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?”
verses.en_bbe: Nicodemus said to him, How is it possible for a man to be given birth when he is old? Is he able to go into his mother's body a second time and come to birth again?

verses.en: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.pt: Jesus respondeu: Em verdade, em verdade te digo que se alguém não nascer da água e do Espírito, não pode entrar no reino de Deus.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said in answer, Truly, I say to you, If a man's birth is not from water and from the Spirit, it is not possible for him to go into the kingdom of God.

verses.en: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.pt: O que é nascido da carne é carne, e o que é nascido do Espírito é espírito.
verses.en_web: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.en_bbe: That which has birth from the flesh is flesh, and that which has birth from the Spirit is spirit.

verses.en: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
verses.pt: Não te admires de eu te haver dito: Necessário vos é nascer de novo.
verses.en_web: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’
verses.en_bbe: Do not be surprised that I say to you, It is necessary for you to have a second birth.

verses.en: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
verses.pt: O vento sopra onde quer, e ouves a sua voz; mas não sabes donde vem, nem para onde vai; assim é todo aquele que é nascido do Espírito.
verses.en_web: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”
verses.en_bbe: The wind goes where its pleasure takes it, and the sound of it comes to your ears, but you are unable to say where it comes from and where it goes: so it is with everyone whose birth is from the Spirit.

verses.en: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
verses.pt: Perguntou-lhe Nicodemos: Como pode ser isto?
verses.en_web: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
verses.en_bbe: And Nicodemus said to him, How is it possible for these things to be?

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Tu és mestre em Israel, e não entendes estas coisas?
verses.en_web: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, answering, said, Are you the teacher of Israel and have no knowledge of these things?

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
verses.pt: Em verdade, em verdade te digo que nós dizemos o que sabemos e testemunhamos o que temos visto; e não aceitais o nosso testemunho!
verses.en_web: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, I say to you, We say that of which we have knowledge; we give witness of what we have seen; and you do not take our witness to be true.

verses.en: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
verses.pt: Se vos falei de coisas terrestres, e não credes, como crereis, se vos falar das celestiais?
verses.en_web: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
verses.en_bbe: If you have no belief when my words are about the things of earth, how will you have belief if my words are about the things of heaven?

verses.en: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
verses.pt: Ora, ninguém subiu ao céu, senão o que desceu do céu, o Filho do homem.
verses.en_web: No one has ascended into heaven, but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
verses.en_bbe: And no one has ever gone up to heaven but he who came down from heaven, the Son of man.

verses.en: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
verses.pt: E como Moisés levantou a serpente no deserto, assim importa que o Filho do homem seja levantado;
verses.en_web: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
verses.en_bbe: As the snake was lifted up by Moses in the waste land, even so it is necessary for the Son of man to be lifted up:

verses.en: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.pt: para que todo aquele que nele crê tenha a vida eterna.
verses.en_web: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.en_bbe: So that whoever has faith may have in him eternal life.

verses.en: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.pt: Porque Deus amou o mundo de tal maneira que deu o seu Filho unigênito, para que todo aquele que nele crê não pereça, mas tenha a vida eterna.
verses.en_web: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.en_bbe: For God had such love for the world that he gave his only Son, so that whoever has faith in him may not come to destruction but have eternal life.

verses.en: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verses.pt: Porque Deus enviou o seu Filho ao mundo, não para que julgasse o mundo, mas para que o mundo fosse salvo por ele.
verses.en_web: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
verses.en_bbe: God did not send his Son into the world to be judge of the world; he sent him so that the world might have salvation through him.

verses.en: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
verses.pt: Quem crê nele não é julgado; mas quem não crê, já está julgado; porquanto não crê no nome do unigênito Filho de Deus.
verses.en_web: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.
verses.en_bbe: The man who has faith in him does not come up to be judged; but he who has no faith in him has been judged even now, because he has no faith in the name of the only Son of God.

verses.en: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
verses.pt: E o julgamento é este: A luz veio ao mundo, e os homens amaram antes as trevas que a luz, porque as suas obras eram más.
verses.en_web: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.
verses.en_bbe: And this is the test by which men are judged: the light has come into the world and men have more love for the dark than for the light, because their acts are evil.

verses.en: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
verses.pt: Porque todo aquele que faz o mal aborrece a luz, e não vem para a luz, para que as suas obras não sejam reprovadas.
verses.en_web: For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
verses.en_bbe: The light is hated by everyone whose acts are evil and he does not come to the light for fear that his acts will be seen.

verses.en: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
verses.pt: Mas quem pratica a verdade vem para a luz, a fim de que seja manifesto que as suas obras são feitas em Deus.
verses.en_web: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
verses.en_bbe: But he whose life is true comes to the light, so that it may be clearly seen that his acts have been done by the help of God.

verses.en: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
verses.pt: Depois disto foi Jesus com seus discípulos para a terra da Judéia, onde se demorou com eles e batizava.
verses.en_web: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them, and baptized.
verses.en_bbe: After these things Jesus and his disciples went into the land of Judaea, and there he was with them for some time, giving baptism.

verses.en: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
verses.pt: Ora, João também estava batizando em Enom, perto de Salim, porque havia ali muitas águas; e o povo ía e se batizava.
verses.en_web: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized.
verses.en_bbe: Now John was then giving baptism at Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there; and people came and were given baptism.

verses.en: For John was not yet cast into prison.
verses.pt: Pois João ainda não fora lançado no cárcere.
verses.en_web: For John was not yet thrown into prison.
verses.en_bbe: For at this time John had not been put into prison.

verses.en: Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Jews about purifying.
verses.pt: Surgiu então uma contenda entre os discípulos de João e um judeu acerca da purificação.
verses.en_web: There arose therefore a questioning on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
verses.en_bbe: Then a question came up between John's disciples and a Jew about washing.

verses.en: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
verses.pt: E foram ter com João e disseram-lhe: Rabi, aquele que estava contigo além do Jordão, do qual tens dado testemunho, eis que está batizando, e todos vão ter com ele.
verses.en_web: They came to John, and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, the same baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
verses.en_bbe: And they went to John and said to him, Rabbi, the man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan, the man to whom you gave witness, is now giving baptism, and everyone is going to him.

verses.en: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
verses.pt: Respondeu João: O homem não pode receber coisa alguma, se não lhe for dada do céu.
verses.en_web: John answered, “A man can receive nothing, unless it has been given him from heaven.
verses.en_bbe: And this was John's answer: A man is unable to have anything if it is not given to him from heaven.

verses.en: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
verses.pt: Vós mesmos me sois testemunhas de que eu disse: Não sou o Cristo, mas sou enviado adiante dele.
verses.en_web: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
verses.en_bbe: You yourselves give witness that I said, I am not the Christ. What I said was, I am sent before the Christ.

verses.en: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
verses.pt: Aquele que tem a noiva é o noivo; mas o amigo do noivo, que está presente e o ouve, regozija-se muito com a voz do noivo. Assim, pois, este meu gozo está completo.
verses.en_web: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. This, my joy, therefore is made full.
verses.en_bbe: He who has the bride is the husband: but the husband's friend, whose place is by his side and whose ears are open to him, is full of joy because of the husband's voice: such is my joy, and it is complete.

verses.en: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.pt: É necessário que ele cresça e que eu diminua.
verses.en_web: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.en_bbe: He has to become greater while I become less.

verses.en: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
verses.pt: Aquele que vem de cima é sobre todos; aquele que vem da terra é da terra, e fala da terra. Aquele que vem do céu é sobre todos.
verses.en_web: He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
verses.en_bbe: He who comes from heaven is greater than all others: he who comes from earth is of the earth, and of the earth are his words: he who comes from heaven is over all.

verses.en: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
verses.pt: Aquilo que ele tem visto e ouvido, isso testifica; e ninguém aceita o seu testemunho.
verses.en_web: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
verses.en_bbe: He gives witness of what he has seen and of what has come to his ears; and no man takes his witness as true.

verses.en: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
verses.pt: Mas o que aceitar o seu testemunho, esse confirma que Deus é verdadeiro.
verses.en_web: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
verses.en_bbe: He who so takes his witness has made clear his faith that God is true.

verses.en: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
verses.pt: Pois aquele que Deus enviou fala as palavras de Deus; porque Deus não dá o Espírito por medida.
verses.en_web: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
verses.en_bbe: For he whom God has sent says God's words; and God does not give him the Spirit by measure.

verses.en: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
verses.pt: O Pai ama ao Filho, e todas as coisas entregou nas suas mãos.
verses.en_web: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
verses.en_bbe: The Father has love for the Son and has put all things into his hands.

verses.en: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
verses.pt: Quem crê no Filho tem a vida eterna; o que, porém, desobedece ao Filho não verá a vida, mas sobre ele permanece a ira de Deus.
verses.en_web: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
verses.en_bbe: He who has faith in the Son has eternal life; but he who has not faith in the Son will not see life; God's wrath is resting on him.
